title: publish sends kaava/publish request
description: Verifies that publishing a topic sends a request and deduplicates repeated identical values.
when: publish('files/active-path', {path: 'a.txt'}) is called twice with equal values
then: Only one kaava/publish request is posted; a different value triggers a new request
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::sends a publish, and does not re-send an unchanged value
